```{ojs}
//| echo: false
mapDiv = {
  if (!scores.length) {
    yield html`<p style="text-align:center;color:gray;margin:3rem 0">Data for this survey is not available yet.</p>`;
    return;
  }
  const div = html`<div style="width:100%;aspect-ratio:${survey.aspect}"></div>`;
  yield div;
  const traces = buildMapTraces(scores, inclusion, domain, showExcluded, survey, domains);
  await Plotly.newPlot(div, traces, mapLayout(domain, survey, domains), {responsive: true, displaylogo: false});
  div.on("plotly_click", ev => {
    const p = ev.points[0];
    const dataTraces = survey.map === "usa" ? 4 : 2;
    if (p.curveNumber >= dataTraces) return;     // excluded regions have no data page
    const isPuertoRico = p.location === "PRI";
    const row = scores.find(r =>
      r.code === p.location || (isPuertoRico && (r.code === "PR" || r.code === "PRI"))
    );
    if (row) window.location.href = `region-data.html?survey=${survey.id}#${encodeURIComponent(row.region)}`;
  });
}
```

<p style="text-align:center;color:gray;font-size:0.9rem">Click a region to see its data.</p>
